scenarios.name: past_changeover_damper_at_min
scenarios.description: Healthy changeover: OAT 30 °C against RAT 22 °C with mechanical cooling at 40% — the unit has handed back to minimum outdoor air (damper 15%), which is the correct response

scenarios.name: past_changeover_damper_still_open
scenarios.description: The fault: OAT 30 °C is 8 °C hotter than return air, mechanical cooling is running, and the OA damper is still at 95% — the unit never stopped economizing; alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: still_favorable_for_economizing
scenarios.description: Temperature conjunct blocking alone: OAT 10 °C is well below the 22 °C return air, so a wide-open damper with cooling running is free cooling doing its job

scenarios.name: no_cooling_call
scenarios.description: Cooling conjunct blocking alone: hot outdoor air and a wide-open damper, but the cooling valve is shut — no mechanical cooling is paying for the outdoor air, so there is no waste to report

scenarios.name: damper_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: damper parked exactly at econ_damper_high_threshold (75%) past changeover with cooling running — the strict `>` keeps it out of the alarm

scenarios.name: damper_just_above_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: damper at 75.1% clears the threshold by a tenth of a point and the alarm follows at 1800 s

scenarios.name: cooling_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: cooling valve exactly at cooling_enabled_threshold (10%) with the damper wide open past changeover — the strict `>` means the coil does not count as cooling

scenarios.name: cooling_just_above_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case, other side: cooling valve at 10.1% counts as mechanical cooling and the alarm follows at 1800 s

scenarios.name: deadband_edge_then_past_changeover
scenarios.description: Edge case: oat − rat sits exactly on temp_deadband (1.0 °C) — no alarm; at t=1200 the outdoor air rises to 23.5 °C, opening the gap to 1.5 °C, and the alarm follows 1800 s later

scenarios.name: damper_closes_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: the economizer is wide open against hot outdoor air with cooling running, but the damper drives to 20% at t=1200 — the condition clears before alarm_delay completes, so no alarm

scenarios.name: damper_cycle_resets_persistence
scenarios.description: Transient: the damper closes at t=900 and drives back open at t=1200 under an unbroken past-changeover-plus-cooling condition — persistence restarts from the reopen, so the alarm lands at 3000 s, not 1800 s
